required_reviewer_role: Relevant specialist or domain-qualified human reviewer before expansion release or score activation.
sensitive_data_limit: Store no diagnoses, allegations, third-party secrets, or unnecessary sensitive narrative; prefer category-level signals.
foreseeable_misuse: Using a boundary label to justify threats, punishment, withdrawal of care, forced agreement, a silent test, or unsafe confrontation.
exclusions: Abuse, coercive control, stalking, discrimination, unsafe dependency, likely retaliation, legal jeopardy, or material danger.
pause_conditions: Pause when safety, power, dependency, retaliation, legal, employment, housing, or caregiving consequences are uncertain.
stop_conditions: Stop if retaliation, coercive control, abuse, stalking, discrimination, unsafe dependency, or material danger is present or becomes likely.
professional_referral_conditions: Seek appropriate trauma-informed, organizational, legal, medical, or emergency support when the low-stakes safety boundary is not met.
release_gate: Specialist safety review complete. | Misuse, exclusion, stop, and escalation paths tested in content and UI. | Scoring remains shadow-only until a separate activation decision.
